meta.note: Class defect: 19 Iraq gas rows misread the OPEC ASB length column, which is headed '(miles)' while the IRAQ block is tabulated in KILOMETRES. Staged as VALIDITY concerns (not fills) because each targets a populated, published value. TWO FAMILIES, TWO DIFFERENT ONE-CELL FIXES: 13 rows (P18xx/P22xx) hold the converted km in LengthKnown with units 'km' -> correct the NUMBER; 6 rows (P40xx) hold the ASB figure verbatim in LengthKnown with units 'mi' -> correct only the UNIT LABEL, never the number. Records were re-targeted 2026-07-28 off the computed LengthKnownKm column onto these editable cells. Memo: notes/escalation-2026-07-28-asb-iraq-length-units.md

resolutions.recommendation: Set LengthKnown 145 -> 90 (LengthKnownUnits stays 'km'). Corrects the computed LengthKnownKm from 145 to 90.
resolutions.researcher_notes: CLASS DEFECT (ASB length units). GEM LengthKnownKm=145 km is exactly 90 x 1.609344 = 144.84. OPEC ASB Table 4.10/9.9 [2012+2017] lists "North Gas/Baiji (2017: Kirkuk/Baiji)" at 90 under a column headed "(miles)", but the IRAQ block is tabulated in KILOMETRES, so the mi->km conversion applied at ingest is spurious. Corroboration that this is the right ASB row and not a numeric coincidence: the ASB diameter for that row is 24 in and GEM carries 24.00. This row has no drawn route, so it is confirmed by arithmetic + diameter only. Proposed LengthKnownKm=90 (the ASB figure read as km). DO NOT paste over LengthMergedKm (computed). Scope + controls: notes/escalation-2026-07-28-asb-iraq-length-units.md.
